thag2.15:1.1: janamhi sambaddho → janasmiṁ sambandho (sya-all) | sambaddho → sambaddho (cck: syā. ka.)
thag2.15:2.3: gacchaṁ taṁ → gaccheyya (sya-all) | gaccheyya → gacchan-taṁ (sya-all: yu.)
thag2.15:2.4: jananti → jananti itthaṁ sudaṁ āyasmā (bj) | jananti sabbamitto thero → janan ti (pts) | heṭhayitvā → bādhayitvā (cck: ka.)
